overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF (TMED) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on health care equity. TMED is an actively managed ETF, aiming to outperform its respective sector index TMED was launched on Jun 11, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.

data.text: Sector ETFs have long been a part of the overall ETF ecosystem. The ETF's transparency, flexibility, and tax efficiency have made it a vehicle for all sorts of sector strategies.
